verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs cover the core of the story. Its Automation Platform runs autonomous background cloud agents from schedules, triggers, integrations and custom webhooks. It also documents API-key headless authentication, agent profiles that set permissions, and run transcripts for observability. The one unsupported part is outcome quality: community notes of agents stopping are general reports, not concrete failures of automations. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled or triggered background automations working reliably.
